title: Making maps with R
hook:
November is the #30DayMapChallenge month! More details can be found on the 30DayMapChallenge GH page.

🎉Categories for

The data this week comes from spData package and the spDataLarge package. The files are loaded inside those packages, so rather than loading the data as typical, please install those packages and use the data from there. Some example code from Geocompution with R book. Rather than supplying datasets, this week we'll be exploring the excellent Geocomputation with R book.
